profile.name: Arthur Arash Briceño Heidari
profile.headline: Solutions Architect · Technical Pre-Sales
profile.summary: Solutions Architect and Technical Pre-Sales professional with a track record of accelerating complex sales cycles across the public and private sectors, combining Cloud (GCP), Generative AI and commercial strategy. I design and deliver PoCs and technical demos that engage C-Level stakeholders, and structure AI-driven commercial proposals and Account Plans that support deal progression.
profile.summarySecondary: Strong technical foundation in SUSE Linux, Rancher, Kubernetes, Docker, Python and SQL, complemented by a background in technical teaching and fluent bilingual communication.

main.summary: Driving business growth at the intersection of Generative AI, Cloud solutions (GCP) and commercial strategy, across the public and private sectors.
highlights: Design, validate and present high-impact PoCs and executive demos to C-Level stakeholders, directly supporting purchase decisions.
Manage the sales pipeline in Salesforce and build complex commercial proposals aligned with each client's needs.
Structure AI-driven Account Plans, identifying expansion opportunities across strategic accounts.
Contribute to the design and tactical execution of the Go-To-Market strategy for Generative AI solutions.
Develop AI projects focused on direct social impact on the lives of Brazilians.

main.summary: Hybrid role with a strong focus on Solution Architecture and pre-sales activities.
highlights: Designed technical solutions and supported customers throughout the evaluation and decision process.
Built and delivered PoCs, demo labs and technical presentations.
Created and maintained demo environments and demo centers used by partners and clients in technical validations.
Supported certifications and technical enablement, strengthening the pre-sales team's capabilities.
Occasionally acted as a Systems Engineer on technical analysis, troubleshooting and solution validation.

main.summary: Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and design effective, scalable solutions focused on SUSE technologies.
highlights: Contributed to solution architecture documentation across more than 5 projects, accelerating onboarding of new engineers and improving technical alignment.
Developed 3 proof-of-concept projects to validate architectural decisions, ensuring alignment with SUSE's standards and best practices.
Took part in evaluating more than 10 technologies and tools, producing technical comparisons that supported pre-sales decisions.
Assisted in the evaluation and selection of appropriate technologies for each implementation.
Completed official SUSE certifications (SLES, Rancher Prime/Kubernetes and SUSE Manager).

main.company: PGFN — Attorney General's Office for the National Treasury
main.summary: Worked with data technologies, automation and information extraction to support Big Data and Data Lake environments.
highlights: Automated data pipelines with Python and SQL, reducing collection and processing time by approximately 70%.
Implemented autonomous extraction routines, saving around 15 hours of manual work per week.
Developed web scraping scripts to extract and process large volumes of data with Selenium, BeautifulSoup and Regex.
Processed data using MySQL, Apache Hive and Spark.

main.summary: Progressive path from computer lab monitor to course coordinator, supporting students in programming, Linux and web development.
highlights: Trained more than 90 students across technical courses and workshops.
Delivered over 700 hours of one-on-one tutoring in programming, logic, Linux and web development.
Coordinated workshops and crash courses in Linux Essentials, Python, HTML/CSS and C, and delivered technical presentations.
Led a Git workshop focused on preparing students for the technology job market.

other.summary: Welcomed guests, managed orders and guided them through a library of 200 to 300 board games, tailoring explanations for beginners and veterans alike. Served international visitors in Portuguese and English, and was named in Google Reviews for service and game knowledge.

Handled photo shoots, retouching and professional image editing in Adobe Photoshop, and prepared layouts for printing. Operated printing equipment, adjusted image quality and assisted customers with custom photo products.

other.company: CEEDV — Center for Special Education for the Visually Impaired
other.summary: Supported children with low vision, complete blindness and multiple disabilities, working alongside teachers in both educational activities and daily care. Accompanied students at recess and lunchtime, assisted with mobility around the school and encouraged independence and social interaction.

Translated documents and handled one-on-one conversation translation when needed. Reviewed, corrected and organised documentation for clarity and accuracy, and built Excel spreadsheets that improved data structure and readability.
Delivered service in a high-end restaurant to a diverse clientele, trained in fine dining etiquette to ensure every detail met the standards of the house.
